issues: J-T007-1 (NOT_SUPPLIED '' vs undefined) and J-T007-4 (ragged rows stricter than GFM spec) are judgement calls for T011 / final review to confirm; each is a one-spot change in compare.ts if re-pinned.
WINDOWS_NOT_TESTED (this VM is Linux; no Windows run was made or claimed).
No performance measurement was made in this card (p95 <=500ms on 32x12 is a T012 gate); compare is a single linear pass over at most 64 KiB with no I/O, but no timing claim is made here.
notes: Strict UTF-8 byte compare of user M vs flatten-generated F(A) with first-diff byte offset + display context; no normalization anywhere (no NFC/NFD, no CRLF folding, no trim, no BOM stripping). NOT_SUPPLIED = undefined or '' (J-T007-1); whitespace-only input is supplied (EXACT_DIFF). GFM subset check: single pipe table only; multi-table, missing delimiter, column mismatch, extra text all diagnosed with 1-based line numbers (J-T007-4: ragged rows stricter than GFM spec). CompareResult carries no witness/proof/collision fields; compare.ts does not import witness.ts. M over 64 KiB UTF-8 throws TableForkError OVER_SIZE; non-string args throw TypeError (J-T007-2). src/io: paste/File/Blob local only, zero network; remote URL source refused before any read (plain Error, J-T007-8). Worker jobId: compare is stateless/pure, takes and returns no jobId; jobId stays in the protocol.ts envelope for T010's ANALYZE handler (J-T007-7).
